extracted.intended_audience: writers (authors) seeking publication with Catapult—especially those of literary fiction and narrative nonfiction; also readers and industry partners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines describing the kinds of books Catapult seeks to publish: literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction that engage readers and challenge assumptions, with an emphasis on craft and diverse voices. Useful for authors preparing submissions or understanding editorial priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre focus: literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Catapult publishes literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The press seeks books in these two broad genres; other kinds of submissions are not highlighted. Emphasis is on narrative, craft, and artful treatment rather than purely commercial genre fiction or nonfiction formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engages with the 'Perception Box' metaphor
rubrics_metrics.description: Works should engage with our Perception Box, the powerful metaphor we use to define the structure and boundaries of how we see others in their full humanity, and invite new ways of seeing and being seen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for books that interrogate perception, challenge assumptions about others, and expand readers' understanding of humanity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prose that is 'alive, insightful, illuminating, and surprising'
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books are alive, insightful, illuminating, and surprising, written by vital voices—emerging and established—that honor the craft of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial preference for vivid, thought-provoking writing that offers fresh perspectives and surprises the reader; signals a high bar for voice and stylistic energy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vital voices: emerging and established writers
rubrics_metrics.description: Written by vital voices—emerging and established—that honor the craft of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The press is open to both new and established authors, prioritizing the vitality and quality of the voice over seniority alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honor the craft of writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Work should 'honor the craft of writing.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations include careful attention to craft elements (voice, structure, language, pacing). Submissions should demonstrate craft competency rather than sloppy or purely idea-driven manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish with care, intention, and respect for authors
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to publishing with care, intention, and respect for our authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a publisher-side standard indicating editorial and production practices: collaborative, respectful editorial process and attention to author needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stories that 'shake up our assumptions and biases'
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books embrace writers and audiences who fearlessly shake up our assumptions and biases; and who believe in the power of storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for work that challenges conventional thinking, provokes reconsideration of beliefs, and leverages storytelling to do intellectual and moral work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore the space between the lines; raise questions rather than provide answers
rubrics_metrics.description: We celebrate stories that explore the space between the lines of our lives, that raise questions rather than give answers, and that rattle the walls of our Perception Box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Valued are ambiguous, inquisitive, or dialogic works that invite reader engagement and interpretation rather than didactic or conclusively resolved narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to diversity and broadening representation
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with a diverse list of writers who have been historically underrepresented, broadening the literary landscape in the United States and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit publisher commitment to seek and publish historically underrepresented voices; diversity is a stated editorial priority in acquisitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embrace writing that requires effort from writer and reader
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writing that requires an effort on the part of both writer and reader to reach beyond our assumptions and biases to see the humanity, struggle, and truth in every human being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for challenging, thoughtful work that may demand active engagement from readers rather than passive consumption; values depth and moral/empathetic work.
